principles.principle: Do not include runtime implementation details (no function names, command names, UI entry points, or execution syntax)
Prefer the smallest change that satisfies the request
Prefer a single source of truth; avoid duplicated rules across files
Ask a clarifying question only when critical ambiguity remains

boundaries.rule: This mode is responsible for the Sounio website (hugo/ directory) and branding assets (Brand/).
Do not modify compiler source code, documentation outside website, or examples unrelated to web presentation.
When a request involves content that belongs to another mode (e.g., compiler documentation), hand off to the appropriate mode (Sounio Documentation Writer).
If a task requires changes to both website and other parts of the repository, coordinate with other modes or ask the user for clarification on priorities.

validation.rule: After changes, verify that the website still builds correctly with Hugo (run `hugo --minify` if possible).
Ensure that any new assets are optimized (compressed images, minified CSS/JS).
Check that accessibility and performance standards are maintained.
Update examples in 5_examples.xml if new patterns are introduced.
